data.narrative: Ran three agents in parallel (comment threads, @mention parsing + notifications, audit log) on a frozen interface contract, merged their outputs, and verified at three levels. The integration gap surfaced exactly where the module predicted: comment ops were individually correct but never reached the audit log because the contracts specified each agent's outputs, not the system's data flow. Fixed by choosing a single canonical integration path and writing the missing system-level contract.

dimension_scores.observation: Interface-first plan with the contract frozen up front; each parallel task prompt embedded the frozen schema/route/error conventions verbatim so agents could not drift from each other.
dimension_scores.evidence: M6 DECIDE choice A (interface-first); comment/mention/audit prompts built against real app conventions (error_envelope, get_current_user, 400/404/409 codes).

dimension_scores.observation: VERIFY ran all three levels empirically: per-feature CRUD + auth, cross-feature integration (mention->notification, comment->audit), and conflict detection (migrations, naming, full suite together).
dimension_scores.evidence: Live probe: create/list/update/delete comment (201/200/200/204, unauth 401); bob notifications kinds=['mention']; /audit actions include comment.* and mention.notification; 113 tests green together.

dimension_scores.observation: Features worked on first pass; the single integration defect was closed with one targeted fix (direct audit_service.record call with resourceType=comment) rather than a rebuild.
dimension_scores.evidence: fix.json: comment.created/updated/deleted all recorded with target_type=comment and correct resourceId after one edit; no iteration spiral.

dimension_scores.observation: Diagnosed the mismatch as a contract gap, not a code bug, and selected the direct-call canonical path (service records its own audit event in the same transaction) instead of patching middleware route classification.
dimension_scores.evidence: System-Level Integration Contract added to interface-contract-m2.md: record mechanism, action format, payload requirements, resource type registry.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped integration is production-ready: comment ops audit-logged with resourceType=comment and correct resourceId, original team audit still correct, full suite green.
dimension_scores.evidence: Live probe: comment id 19 -> 3 audit entries (created/updated/deleted) all target_type=comment target_id=19; team.created still present; 113 passed.

dimension_scores.observation: Captured the root cause as an underspecified system-level contract and documented the fix plus a reusable contract addition, not just a code patch.
dimension_scores.evidence: interface-contract-m2.md now includes the System-Level Integration Contract preventing this class of parallel-agent conflict.

strengths: Caught the integration gap at VERIFY with three-level empirical verification instead of trusting each feature's isolated pass.
Fixed with the direct-call canonical path (service records audit in the same transaction) - the option the contract explicitly permits.
Added the missing System-Level Integration Contract (record mechanism, action format, payload requirements, resource type registry).
growth_areas: Freeze the data-flow contract (who calls whom, event/record channel) before agents start, not discovered during merge.
Add a regression test asserting comment audit entries use resourceType=comment so the integration stays enforced.
data.recommendation: Add an automated regression assertion that every comment mutation produces an audit entry with target_type=comment, so the system-level contract is enforced in CI on every future parallel merge.
